selected_problem: After the authentication boundary became externally blocked, fresh-main inspection returned to the current semantic-repository truth boundary. The existing resolver had a narrower directly falsifiable defect: an explicit relative specifier such as './foo.js' could resolve to 'foo.js.map' or 'foo.js/index.js' when the exact 'foo.js' file did not exist, because extension and index inference was applied even after the caller had already supplied an extension.
decision_basis: The parent semantic boundary remains broad, but this child defect is narrow, evidence-rich and independent of choosing a complete parser, bundler or package-resolution architecture.
Explicitly named file extensions already express a concrete path intent; failing closed when that exact path is absent avoids inventing a second suffix or directory-index interpretation.
Extensionless relative imports retain the existing bounded inference behavior, so this change does not replace the current resolver architecture.
changes: core/semantic-repo-graph.mjs now detects whether the normalized relative import basename already has an explicit extension.
For explicit-extension imports, the semantic graph links only an exact repository path and otherwise records no import edge; extension and index fallback remain available for extensionless imports.
tests/semantic-import-target-resolution.test.mjs adds regressions for source-map/index lookalikes and preserves exact/extensionless behavior.

verification.pre_fix_reproduction: PASS: current-main resolver logic mapped ./foo.js to src/foo.js.map when the exact file was absent, reproducing a false semantic edge.
verification.syntax_check: PASS: the patched semantic-repo-graph.mjs parses under node --check in a faithful local source replay.
verification.focused_module_replay: 3/3 PASS: extensionless inference still resolves foo.js; explicit foo.js rejects foo.js.map and foo.js/index.js lookalikes; explicit foo.js still resolves the exact foo.js path when present.
verification.hosted_runtime: Developer Execution Runtime remains transiently unavailable with HTTP 502; no hosted DWAC execution success is claimed.

truth_boundary: Filesystem case/Unicode identity, conflicting-content aliases outside the current lexical canonicalization model, complete parser-grade Node/TypeScript/bundler/package module resolution, and arbitrary complex repository synthesis remain UNRESOLVED. This cycle closes only the false extra-suffix/index fallback for explicit-extension relative imports.
